features: The agent reports 30 days of crashes: blue screens with stop code and parameters, unexpected shutdowns, WHEA hardware errors. Stop code and probable driver come from minidumps that stay on the device.
The agent reports the edition, installation type, display version, update revision, product name and build of Windows, so that the portal can show the support status of the operating system.
The agent reports the installed programs from the uninstall keys of the registry, without paths or user names. It sends the list only when its checksum changes.
The agent reports the BitLocker state of every volume: encryption, protection, method and the kinds of key protectors. It never reads recovery passwords or other secrets.
